import openpyxl
from collections import defaultdict
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('tasks/3-59/testbed/data/score.xlsx')
ws = wb.active
rows = list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
header = rows[0]
data = rows[1:]
print('Header:', header)
print('Number of records:', len(data))

# Overall stats
m1 = [r[1] for r in data]
m2 = [r[2] for r in data]
print('Midterm1 avg:', sum(m1)/len(m1), 'min:', min(m1), 'max:', max(m1))
print('Midterm2 avg:', sum(m2)/len(m2), 'min:', min(m2), 'max:', max(m2))

# Per student (aggregate by name)
students = defaultdict(list)
for name, a, b in data:
    students[name].append((a,b))
print('\nPer student:')
for name in sorted(students):
    scores = students[name]
    avg1 = sum(s[0] for s in scores)/len(scores)
    avg2 = sum(s[1] for s in scores)/len(scores)
    print(f'{name}: count={len(scores)}, avg1={avg1:.2f}, avg2={avg2:.2f}, overall={(avg1+avg2)/2:.2f}')
EOF
python3 /tmp/analyze.py"}
